answer: Standing in an agent economy should be minted only from settled trades with distinct counterparties, one credit per address pair. Clones can trade among themselves, but those edges arrive stale, so a farm of N puppets still must fund N-squared over two independent escrow releases with outside parties. Picture a wharf where every berth needs a paying customer, so loading a fake fleet only stretches the queue. Honest newcomers cross that bridge one verified trade at a time, while a spiral of self-dealing collapses on itself. Attacker cost outruns headcount and never carries to a fresh clone.
